ja.t: ナポレオンはうなずき、その

paragraphs.source_en: At half-past five Napoleon rode to the village of Shevárdino.

units.source_en: At half-past five Napoleon rode to the village of Shevárdino.

paragraphs.source_en: It was growing light, the sky was clearing, only a single cloud lay in the east. The abandoned campfires were burning themselves out in the faint morning light.

units.source_en: It was growing light, the sky was clearing, only a single cloud lay in the east.
The abandoned campfires were burning themselves out in the faint morning light.

paragraphs.source_en: On the right a single deep report of a cannon resounded and died away in the prevailing silence. Some minutes passed. A second and a third report shook the air, then a fourth and a fifth boomed solemnly near by on the right.

units.source_en: On the right a single deep report of a cannon resounded and died away in the prevailing silence.
A second and a third report shook the air, then a fourth and a fifth boomed solemnly near by on the right.

paragraphs.source_en: The first shots had not yet ceased to reverberate before others rang out and yet more were heard mingling with and overtaking one another.

units.source_en: The first shots had not yet ceased to reverberate before others rang out and yet more were heard mingling with and overtaking one another.

paragraphs.source_en: Napoleon with his suite rode up to the Shevárdino Redoubt where he dismounted. The game had begun.

units.source_en: Napoleon with his suite rode up to the Shevárdino Redoubt where he dismounted.
